DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 雨が強いですね。こちらでお探しのものはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Malakas ang ulan. May hinahanap po ba kayo rito?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 雨で靴下がびしょぬれになりました。今すぐ履き替えたいんですが、紳士用の靴下はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 雨で靴下が濡れ今すぐ履き替えるため紳士用靴下を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Basang-basa ang medyas ko sa ulan. Gusto kong magpalit agad; may panlalaking medyas po ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihing nabasa ang medyas at magtanong ng panlalaki para makapagpalit agad. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 日用品の棚にあります。こちらは二十五から二十七センチ用で、一足四百四十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Nasa estante ng gamit pang-araw-araw. Ito ay para sa 25–27 sentimetro at 440 yen ang isang pares.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 靴は二十八センチです。そのサイズを無理に履くより、大きいものを探したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 靴が二十八センチのため小さいサイズではなく大きい靴下を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: 28 sentimetro ang sapatos ko. Mas mabuting maghanap ng mas malaki kaysa ipilit ang sukat na iyan?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihing 28 sentimetro ang sapatos at ikonsulta ang mas malaking medyas. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらに二十七から二十九センチ用もあります。表示の範囲でしたら、こちらが合いそうです。値段は同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: May para sa 27–29 rito. Ayon sa saklaw sa label, mas bagay ito. Pareho ang presyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 大きい方にします。もし開けて履いてみて合わなかったら、交換できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 大きいサイズを選び開封着用後のサイズ交換を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Mas malaki ang kukunin ko. Kung mabuksan at maisuot pero hindi kasya, maaari bang palitan?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Piliin ang malaki at itanong ang pagpapalit matapos buksan at isuot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 当店では開封して着用した靴下のサイズ交換は受けていません。袋のサイズ表示を確かめてからお求めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hindi kami nagpapalit ng sukat ng nabuksan at naisuot na medyas. Tingnan muna ang label sa supot bago bumili.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二十七から二十九センチと書いてありますね。買ったあと、店の中で履き替えられる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: サイズ表示を確認し購入後に店内で履き替えられる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: 27–29 sentimetro ang nakasulat. May lugar ba sa tindahan para magpalit matapos bumili?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang sukat at itanong ang lugar sa loob para magpalit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お客様用の更衣場所はありません。出入口では通行の妨げになるので、履き替える場所は別に確保してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Wala kaming changing area. Makakaharang sa pasukan, kaya humanap ng ibang lugar para magpalit.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: わかりました。車で履き替えます。大きい方を一足と、濡れた靴下を入れる袋をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 車で履き替えると伝え大きい靴下一足と濡れた靴下用の袋を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Sige po, sa kotse ako magpapalit. Isang pares ng malaki at isang bag para sa basang medyas po.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Sabihing sa kotse magpapalit at humingi ng malaking medyas at bag ng basa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 一足四百四十円と袋三円で、四百四十三円です。ありがとうございました。雨で足元が滑りやすいので、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: 440 yen ang pares at 3 yen ang bag, 443 lahat. Salamat. Madulas sa ulan kaya mag-ingat.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 包装用品をお探しですか。袋とリボンはこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Pambalot ang hinahanap? Nasa rito ang bag at ribbon.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 別の店で買ったノートを贈りたいです。この半透明の袋だと、中身が見えてしまいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 他店購入のノートを贈るため半透明袋では中身が見えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Gusto kong iregalo ang notebook na binili sa ibang tindahan. Kita ang laman sa translucent na bag na ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihing pangregalo ang notebook sa ibang tindahan at kita sa bag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 中身を見せたくないなら、こちらの柄入りの紙袋はいかがですか。口を折って閉じるタイプです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Kung ayaw makita, itong patterned paper bag? Itinitiklop ang bungad para isara.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ノートは縦二十一センチ、横十五センチです。この紙袋に入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: ノートの縦二十一横十五センチを伝え紙袋に収まるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: 21 sentimetro ang taas at 15 ang lapad ng notebook. Kasya rito?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang 21 at 15 at itanong kung kasya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 袋の内側は縦二十六センチ、横十八センチです。ノートを入れても、上を折る余裕がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: 26 ang loob na taas at 18 ang lapad. May sapat pang tiklupan sa itaas kahit may notebook.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この袋にします。口を閉じるシールも付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 紙袋を選び封をするシールが付くか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Ito ang pipiliin ko. Kasama ang sticker na pangsara?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Piliin ang bag at itanong ang kasamang sticker. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: シールは付属していません。こちらの封かんシールは十枚入りで、紙袋と同じく税込み百十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Walang kasama. Itong sampung sealing sticker ay 110 yen kasama ang buwis, gaya ng bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 袋とシールで二百二十円ですね。ノートを持ってきたら、店で包んでもらえるんでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 合計二百二十円を確認し店でノートを包んでもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: 220 ang bag at sticker. Kung dalhin ang notebook, kayo ang magbabalot?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Kumpirmahin ang 220 at itanong ang serbisyo sa pagbalot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 当店では包装サービスは行っていません。袋とシールを使って、ご自身で包んでいただく形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Wala kaming wrapping service. Kayo ang magbabalot gamit ang bag at sticker.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それなら家で包みます。紙袋を一枚とシールを一袋お願いします。ノートを入れてから口を折って留めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 自宅で包むと伝え袋一枚とシール一袋を購入し封の手順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Sa bahay ko gagawin. Isang paper bag at isang pakete ng sticker. Ilalagay ang notebook, itutupi, at isasara.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Sabihing sa bahay, bilhin ang bag at pakete, at ulitin ang pagsasara. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい、二点で二百二十円です。袋を折らないようにお入れしますね。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Oo, 220 ang dalawa. Ilalagay nang hindi natutupi ang bag. Salamat, bumalik kayo.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 口座開設のご案内をご覧ですね。ご不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tinitingnan ang gabay ng pagbukas ng account. May hindi malinaw?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: アプリで申し込むと書いてありますが、スマートフォンを持っていません。窓口では相談できないんでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: スマートフォンがなくアプリを使えないため窓口相談できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Nakasulat na app ang application pero wala akong smartphone. Hindi ba puwedeng kumonsulta sa counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang smartphone at itanong ang counter. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 当店では窓口でのご相談も受けています。アプリを使えないという理由だけで、ご相談をお断りすることはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Tumatanggap din kami rito ng konsultasyon. Hindi kayo tatanggihan dahil lang hindi makagamit ng app.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それなら安心しました。申込書や説明も紙で読めるようにしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 窓口相談に安心したと伝え申込書と説明を紙で読めるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Panatag ako. Maaari bang papel ang application at paliwanag para mabasa?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihing panatag at humiling ng papel na form at paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 紙の案内をお渡しできます。お申込みの進め方は、担当者が必要書類と一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: May paper guide. Ang paraan ng application ay titiyakin ng responsable kasama ang kailangang dokumento.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日は給与の振込先を作りたいと思って来ました。在留カードはありますが、印鑑は持ってきていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 給与用の目的と在留カード持参、印鑑未持参を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Account ng suweldo ang sadya ko ngayon. Dala ko ang residence card pero wala ang personal seal.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pangsahod, residence card, at walang seal. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 給与用という目的と、今日お持ちの書類を担当者にお伝えください。印鑑が必要かも含めて、こちらの窓口で確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sabihin sa responsable ang sahod at dalang dokumento. Dito titiyakin pati kung kailangan ang seal.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 連絡先は家の固定電話しかありません。その番号を相談票に書いても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自宅固定電話しかないため相談票の連絡先に使えるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Landline lang sa bahay ang contact ko. Maaari bang iyon sa consultation slip?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Sabihing landline lang at itanong ang paggamit sa slip. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この相談票には、ご本人に連絡できる番号をご記入ください。今後の利用に必要な連絡方法は、担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Dito, numerong makokontak kayo ang ilagay. Ipapaliwanag ng responsable ang kailangan para sa susunod na paggamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 家の番号を記入します。今日は窓口で書類を確認してもらい、必要なものがわかってから申込みを進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 家の番号を記入し必要物を確認してから申込みを進めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Ilalagay ko ang bahay. Titingnan muna ang dokumento rito at itutuloy ang application kapag alam ang kailangan.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Isulat ang bahay at sabihin ang pagtiyak bago application. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。紙の案内と相談票をお持ちになって、二番窓口へどうぞ。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGS-SHIMABARA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Sige. Dalhin ang paper guide at slip sa counter 2. Paalam po.

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここに二便分の箱があります。どの便の箱へ入れる指示ですか。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二便のどの箱へ氷を入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. May mga kahon para sa dalawang biyahe. Aling biyahe ang lalagyan?
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung alin sa dalawang biyahe ang lalagyan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先に出す一便目だけです。札で区別してください。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Unang aalis na biyahe lang. Ihiwalay gamit ang tag.

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一便目の青い札を確認します。二便目の箱が隣にあっても、一緒には入れません。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札を照合して二便目を対象外にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Titiyakin ang asul na tag ng una. Kahit katabi ang pangalawa, hindi ko isasabay.
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itugma ang tag at huwag isama ang pangalawa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 氷の量も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Matitiyak mo rin ang dami ng yelo?

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 目印までですね。箱の重さだけで量を決めず、目印を見て入れます。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 量の目印で補充すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hanggang marka po. Hindi bigat lang ang batayan; titingnan ang marka sa paglagay.
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Kumpirmahing ayon sa markang dami magdadagdag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 補充前の状態は記録してください。

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真を撮って記録します。魚が見えにくい箱は、無理に手で探らず担当へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 補充前記録と見えにくい箱の報告を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kukunan ng litrato at itatala. Kung mahirap makita ang isda, hindi hahalughugin ng kamay; sasabihin sa responsable.
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang tala bago dagdag at pag-ulat ng hindi kitang kahon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 補充が終わったら、何を報告しますか。

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一便目の箱数と補充完了を報告します。二便目は作業していないことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 作業箱数と対象外便の未実施を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Bilang ng kahon sa unang biyahe at tapos nang dagdag. Sasabihin ding hindi ginawa ang pangalawa.
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iulat ang kahon at tapos na gawa, at hindi ginawang pangalawa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でお願いします。青い札の箱だけ、記録を取ってから補充してください。
DLG-SC-NGT-MURAKAMI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Iyan ang gawin. Asul lang at itala muna bago dagdagan.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈り物のお茶をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。相手は急須を持っていないので、茶葉の袋だけでは使いにくいかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手に急須がない贈答条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Walang teapot ang pagbibigyan kaya baka mahirap ang tea leaves lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang walang teapot na kondisyon ng regalo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ティーバッグもあります。温かいお茶を飲まれる方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: May tea bags din. Umiinom ba ng mainit?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事中は水筒で冷たいお茶を飲みます。お湯を用意できるかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷茶用水筒とお湯の未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Malamig sa tumbler habang trabaho. Hindi ko pa naitanong kung may mainit na tubig.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang cold tumbler at hindi pa tiyak na init. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お湯用と水出し用では表示を確認した方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Dapat tingnan ang label para sa mainit at cold brew.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では水出しの表示があるものを見たいです。ティーバッグなら何でも水出しできるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水出し表示のある商品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Cold-brew label sana. Hindi ko iisiping lahat ng tea bags ay puwede sa malamig na tubig.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Humiling ng may label na cold brew. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが水出し用の設定です。大きな箱と小さな袋があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ito ang cold-brew na opsiyon. May malaking kahon at maliit na supot.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最初は小さな袋にします。相手の水筒の大きさが分からないので、一度試しやすい量にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明な容器サイズに合わせ試しやすい量を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Maliit muna. Hindi alam ang tumbler size kaya kaunting madaling subukan ang gusto.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Piliin ang madaling subukang dami dahil hindi alam ang lalagyan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 包装はどうされますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 簡単な包装をお願いします。作り方の表示を隠さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 作り方表示を隠さない包装を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Simpleng balot po. Huwag matakpan ang paraan ng paggawa sa label.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Humiling ng balot na hindi natatakpan ang instruction. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 小さな水出し用を承りました。作り方が見える包み方にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Maliit na cold brew ang napili. Ibabalot na kita ang paggawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 建物の見学をご希望ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。土間までは靴のままでよいようですが、どこで脱ぐのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 靴を脱ぐ境目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Mukhang sapatos hanggang doma pero hindi ko alam kung saan aalisin.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang hangganan ng pag-alis ng sapatos. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 木の段の手前で脱ぎます。靴置きへ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bago ang kahoy na baitang. Ilagay sa sapatusan.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 段の手前ですね。連れが後から来るので、靴を脱ぐ所を先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 境目を復唱し遅れて来る同行者へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bago baitang. Mahuhuli ang kasama kaya sasabihin ko muna ang hubaran.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ulitin ang hangganan at sabihin sa mahuhuling kasama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お荷物は大きいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 背中のリュックが柱に当たりそうです。中では前に持ち、展示品に触れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: リュックが柱に当たらない持ち方を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Baka tumama ang backpack sa haligi. Sa loob hahawakan sa harap at iiwas sa eksibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pagdala ng backpack para hindi tumama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真は表示のある範囲で撮れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaari ang litrato sa saklaw ng karatula.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。撮影できる場所でも、ほかの人が畳へ上がる所をふさがないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影時に畳入口をふさがないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sige. Kahit puwedeng kumuha, hindi haharangan ang pasukan sa tatami ng iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi haharang sa tatami habang kumukuha. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見学後はこちらへ戻って靴を履きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Dito babalik para isuot ang sapatos matapos maglibot.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ靴置きに戻るのですね。自分の靴の位置を覚えてから上がります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同じ靴置きへの帰路と自分の靴の位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Parehong sapatusan. Tatandaan ko ang akin bago umakyat.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang balik at puwesto ng sariling sapatos. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。段の前で靴を脱ぎ、順路を回って同じ場所へお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo. Hubad bago baitang at sundan ang ruta pabalik dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 店内でお召し上がりですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持ち帰りです。一時間後に食べるので、たれを先に全部かけず、別にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持帰りと別添えたれを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Takeout po. Sa isang oras kakainin kaya sarsa hiwalay, hindi lahat ibubuhos muna?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng takeout at hiwalay na sarsa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: たれは別の容器にできます。天ぷらの種類はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Puwedeng hiwalay na lalagyan. Napili ang tempura?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 野菜を三つお願いします。魚介の天ぷらを混ぜる注文ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 野菜三つで魚介を混ぜないと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Tatlong gulay po. Hindi order na may halong seafood.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tukuyin ang tatlong gulay at walang seafood. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: たれは一つでよいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、一つで十分です。料理の袋の中でこぼれないよう、ふたを確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: たれ一つと容器ふた確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Maaari bang tiyakin ang takip para hindi tumapon sa bag ng pagkain?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Humiling ng isang sarsa at pagtiyak ng takip. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ふたを閉め、袋の横へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Isasara at ilalagay sa gilid ng bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。天ぷらは上から重い物を載せずに持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理を重い物でつぶさない持ち方を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Salamat. Hindi papatungan ng mabigat ang tempura sa pagdala.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagdala nang walang mabigat na ipapatong. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で食べるので不要です。野菜三つと、別容器のたれ一つでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箸不要と最終数量を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sa bahay kakain kaya hindi. Tatlong gulay at isang hiwalay na sarsa po.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tanggihan ang chopsticks at kumpirmahin ang dami. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で承りました。たれの容器を確認してから、分けてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Titiyakin ang sarsa saka ibibigay nang hiwalay.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: サイズのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昨日買ったこの靴が小さいです。交換できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入靴のサイズ交換希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, maliit ang sapatos na binili kahapon. Gusto kong ikonsulta kung maaaring palitan.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang gustong pagpapalit ng biniling sapatos. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レシートと、使用状態を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Patingin ng resibo at kalagayan ng paggamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: レシートはこちらです。家の中で試しただけですが、確認はお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートと室内試着のみの使用状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito ang resibo. Sa bahay lang sinubukan pero pakitingnan pa rin.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang resibo at ipaliwanag na sa loob lang sinubukan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 交換できるか確認しながら、大きいサイズを試せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Habang tinitingnan ang palitan, puwedeng subukan ang mas malaki.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。持ってきた靴と店の試着品が混ざらないよう、私の靴は箱に戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参品と店の候補を箱で分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakiusap. Ibabalik sa kahon ang akin para hindi mahalo sa paninda.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay sa kahon ang sariling sapatos sa tindahan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが候補のサイズです。両足で試してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ito ang opsiyong sukat. Subukan ang dalawang paa.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両足を試します。右だけ合っていても、左がきつければ選びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 左右両足の適合を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pareho po. Kahit kanan ay tama, hindi pipiliin kung masikip ang kaliwa.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing parehong paa ang titiyakin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 履き心地はいかがですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左右とも合います。交換の条件を確認できたら、このサイズへ変更したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 適合結果を伝え条件確認後に交換を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Parehong kasya. Kung natiyak ang kondisyon ng palitan, gusto kong sukat na ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagkasya at hilingin ang palitan matapos kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 持参品の状態とレシートを担当が確認します。条件が合ってから交換手続きを進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Responsable ang titingin ng resibo at dala. Tutuloy kung pasok sa kondisyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 注文のお品は、もう少しお待ちいただきます。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同行者に受取を頼んで、私は先に席へ行ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者へ受取を任せ自分は席へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Maaari bang kasama ang kukuha at mauuna ako sa upuan?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang kasama sa pickup at sariling mauuna sa upuan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取札をその方へ渡してください。お品は二つでよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ibigay ang claim tag sa kaniya. Dalawa ang pagkain, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、二つです。一つだけ受け取って終わりと思わないよう、数も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二個の数量を同行者へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, dalawa. Sasabihin din ang bilang para hindi isang kuha lang ang isipin niyang tapos.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin sa kasama ang dalawang bilang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 辛さの違いもありますね。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、一つは普通、もう一つは辛さなしです。札だけでなく、その違いも同行者へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 辛さの異なる二種を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo, isang normal at isang walang anghang. Hindi tag lang, ipapaliwanag ko rin iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang dalawang magkaibang anghang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出来上がったら番号でお呼びします。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 呼ばれる番号と二つの注文を、ここで同行者に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 呼出番号と注文を受取者に確認させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dito ipapatitiyak ko sa kasama ang numero at dalawang order.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipatiyak sa kukuha ang numero at order. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いいえ、会場の席で食べます。私は奥の白いテーブルにいると同行者へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会場での喫食と合流するテーブルを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi, sa upuan ng lugar kakain. Sasabihing nasa puting mesa ako sa likod.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagkain sa venue at puting tagpuan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。札を持った方へ、種類を確認して二つお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Sa may tag, titiyakin ang uri at ibibigay ang dalawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: チャージはいくらにされますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 残高を三千円くらいにしたいです。三千円を追加する意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目標残高と追加額を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gustong mga 3,000 ang balanse. Hindi dagdag na 3,000 ang ibig sabihin.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang gustong balanse at dagdag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の残高を確認してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaari bang tingnan ang balanse ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。このカードです。残高を覚えていないので、先に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カードを提示し現在残高を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, itong card. Hindi maalala kaya tingnan muna.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang card at ipatiyak ang balanse. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 残高は千二百円です。追加する金額を決めてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 千円追加なら二千二百円ですね。使える追加単位を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 計算と追加単位を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kung 1,000, 2,200 iyon. Anong denomination ang puwedeng idagdag?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kalkulasyon at itanong ang unit ng load. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでは千円単位で追加できます。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では二千円追加にします。残高は三千二百円になると理解しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二千円追加と予想残高を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: 2,000 ang idagdag. Nauunawaan kong 3,200 ang magiging balanse.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang 2,000 dagdag at inaasahang balanse. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二千円をお預かりしてよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。追加は二千円でお願いします。三千円追加ではないことを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加額を復唱し処理後残高を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo, dagdag 2,000. Gusto kong tiyaking hindi 3,000 na dagdag.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ulitin ang dagdag at tiyakin ang balanse pagkatapos. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二千円を追加しました。残高三千二百円の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGT-MURAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nagdagdag ng 2,000. Tingnan ang 3,200 na display.
